name: ScrollStack-TS-TW
blurb: Cards stack and scale as you scroll, compressing into a deck.
description: A scroll-triggered stacking animation where multiple cards compress and scale down as the user scrolls. Uses Lenis for smooth scrolling. Items accumulate at a stack position while earlier cards fade. Highly configurable: itemScale, rotation, blur, base scale.
use_when: Showcasing process steps, feature highlights, or content flows in an engaging scroll narrative.
avoid_when: Users with prefers-reduced-motion — heavy scroll animation may cause discomfort.
a11y: Content is readable, but scroll-driven effects are visual-only. Consider skipping animation for motion-sensitive users.
